value.rationale: The natural last nonreconstructible six-symbol order is a finite sharp boundary for complete-set permutation trace reconstruction. The full classification isolates exactly ten ambiguous sources, yields the optimal size 714 of a full-set-decoding dictionary and counts its 36 labeled optimizers. This goes beyond known existence of a pair or a threshold; the full-trace-set observation model and its limits are explicit.
